title: Exclude /temp from the OSF workspace file groups
summary: A one-line change to the OSF workspace configuration: the `fileGroups` block in `.osf/moon.yml` gains an ignore pattern for `/temp/**`, so the scratch directory at the repository root is no longer swept into the workspace's tracked file set. Everything else in the config — the other ignore patterns, the workspace definition, and the tasks that consume these file groups — is untouched.

nodes.summary: The ordered list of glob patterns that defines the workspace's tracked file set. Excludes are applied after includes, so a new `!` entry narrows the set without touching any include.

nodes.subtitle: new exclude pattern
nodes.summary: The added line. It removes the repository-root `temp/` directory from every file group that inherits this list, matching the existing treatment of `.osf/out`, `.superpowers`, `.worktrees` and the other scratch paths.
